correctness.rationale: The special-time identity follows rigorously from finite-field Frobenius plus the elementary lift A congruent B mod p^k implies A^p congruent B^p mod p^(k+1). Base-p time factorization and the finite-seed epoch formula follow algebraically, and a standalone verifier checks representative masks, moduli, times, and seeds.

originality.rationale: Prime-field Frobenius recurrence, empirical prime-power ladders, additive cellular automata over finite rings, and prime-power Lucas-type congruences are prior work and excluded from the novelty claim. The claim is restricted to the explicit source-specific prime-power renormalization, arbitrary-time digit factorization, and epoch identities for the dynamics highlighted as computational in arXiv:2609.20416v1. No overlapping SCOPE record or indexed source-specific statement was found.

value.rationale: The result converts the source paper's mod-4/mod-8/mod-9 computational recurrence signatures into exact all-mask/all-seed algebraic laws and strengthens special-time recurrence to an arbitrary-time multiscale factorization of the complete constant-modulus orbit.
